description: Land Title Settlement Department - Haragama, Kandy Four Gravets and Gangawata Koralaya D/S Division, Kandy District - Cad Map No. 320289
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels, including details about land ownership, parcel numbers, extents, and encumbrances. The content falls under "Land registrations, property ownership, land titles" as specified in the Land Gazettes (Type 4) classification, and appears in the "PART III - LANDS" section of the gazette.
